presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths: four participants with long labels, five turns, two exhibits, long element labels, four relationships with long captions and a four-step traversal.
presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: the exploded plan keeps every caption beside its own line and every label nearer its own piece; with six near-maximum turns listed in the panel, four 45–49 character participant labels, 33–45 character element labels and a fourth relationship, the panel overflows at 16:9 and 1:1 and, at 1:1, the questioner label and a fourth relationship caption find no free floor. Tried before capping (text 22.5 down to 16.4 px at every ratio): text column and bands of 2–4 columns, room width searched with narrower card wrapping, room scales, table beside or below the witness box, label/badge orders. Rendered BEFORE (hold, 1080p): 16:9 16.4 px / people 80.6 px with panel-overflow; 9:16 19.8 / 84.0; 1:1 16.4 / 75.5 with panel-overflow. AFTER the cap (five turns of 30–36 characters, participant labels 35–37, element labels 30–41, three relationships with 37–54 character captions, a three-step traversal): 16:9 17.1 / 80.4; 9:16 19.8 / 87.7; 1:1 16.4 / 53.5 (1:1 stress floor 45 px); no problems. Every capped field stays longer than its baseline. Pre-cap preset: production/scratch/hearings-03/LAW-0290.presets.precap.json.
